items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: But I wasn’t around Nat as much as that because Nat would be with another crowd when he’d come to New Orleans and Cannonball would be with us you know.

ctx.x: And Nat, you know, contributed a lot to the success of that quintet with his tunes.

Well Nat was more stable, and you know, he was more the other type than Cannonball. Cannon was just happy-go-lucky, let’s have some fun. But Nat was, you know, he was in the business part of it. But I wasn’t around Nat as much as that because Nat would be with another crowd when he’d come to New Orleans and Cannonball would be with us you know.
That’s a shame he went so early.
